claim: IRC general-use receptacles (E3901.2): installed so that no point along the floor line in any wall space is more than 6 ft (1.8 m), measured horizontally, from an outlet in that space; wall spaces 2 ft (600 mm) or wider count.
ref: IRC E3901.2 as quoted in Town of Morrison (CO) Building Department, Information Sheet 06 'Residential Construction'

claim: IRC kitchen countertop receptacles (E3901.4): installed so that no point along the counter wall line is more than 24 in (600 mm) from a receptacle outlet; every counter space wider than 12 in (300 mm) gets an outlet.
ref: IRC E3901.4 as quoted in Town of Morrison (CO) Building Department, Information Sheet 06

claim: IRC bathroom receptacle (E3901.6): at least one wall receptacle outlet within 3 ft (900 mm) of each basin location.
ref: IRC E3901.6 as quoted in Town of Morrison (CO) Building Department, Information Sheet 06

claim: IRC E3903: at least one wall-switch-controlled lighting outlet in every habitable room, bathroom and hallway; interior stairways with 6 or more risers have a lighting control wall switch at each level.
ref: IRC E3903 as quoted in Town of Morrison (CO) Building Department, Information Sheet 06

claim: IRC R314.3: smoke alarms in each sleeping room, outside each separate sleeping area in the immediate vicinity of the bedrooms, and on each additional story including basements and habitable attics.
ref: IRC R314.3 as quoted in City of Casa Grande (AZ) Building Department handout 'Smoke and CO' (2024)

claim: IRC 2021 R315.2.1 and R315.3: CO alarms required where the dwelling contains a fuel-fired appliance or has an attached garage with an opening to the dwelling; installed outside each separate sleeping area in the immediate vicinity of the bedrooms (and inside a bedroom that contains a fuel-burning appliance or whose attached bathroom does).
ref: IRC 2021 R315.2.1, R315.3 as quoted in Anne Arundel County (MD) 'Carbon Monoxide Alarms'; R315.3 also in City of Casa Grande handout

claim: IRC 2024 local exhaust: kitchen 100 cfm (47 L/s) intermittent or 25 cfm (12 L/s) continuous; bathroom 50 cfm (24 L/s) intermittent or 20 cfm (9 L/s) continuous.
ref: IRC 2024 M1505.4 local exhaust rates as stated in Larimer County (CO) Community Development 'Whole House Mechanical Ventilation' (handout gives the rates without the table number)

claim: CORRECTED: IRC R307.2 requires the nonabsorbent wall finish in shower compartments and above tubs with shower heads to extend not less than 6 ft (1829 mm) above the floor (not above the drain).
ref: IRC R307.2 as quoted in City of Casa Grande (AZ) Building Department handout 'Bathroom Clearances' (2024)
